technical_and_design_decisions: All new separate SPI repositories will use the same build system as the existing admin project and adhere to the project's established code style, testing, and CI/CD standards.

The new {{undeployed}} status will be added as a new enum value to a shared status contract used across all deployer SPIs, with consistent semantics defined for streams with no associated deployment context.

SPI extraction will only move SPI-specific code and dependencies to the new repositories, leaving core admin project logic intact, with the admin project referencing the new SPI repos as external dependencies.
The existing unreleased Mesos SPI work will be included in the new dedicated Mesos SPI repository, with the associated PR submitted against the new Mesos repo.
All status handling changes will include unit test coverage for the new {{undeployed}} status, and existing tests will be updated as needed to account for the new status value.
assumptions: The existing admin project's SPI code is sufficiently modularized that extracting each SPI variant into a separate repository will not require major refactoring of core business logic.

Existing status handling code does not have hardcoded assumptions that only the current set of status values (including {{unknown}}) exist, so adding the new {{undeployed}} status will not cause unexpected runtime errors.

The project has established, reusable CI/CD pipeline templates, testing standards, and PR review processes that can be applied to the new separate SPI repositories without additional custom configuration.
There are no conflicting, unreviewed changes to the Mesos SPI code in the admin project that would complicate the extraction process or PR submission for the existing Mesos work.

All SPIs either share a common status contract that can be updated to add the new {{undeployed}} status, or can be updated independently with consistent semantics as defined in the initial analysis activity.
The version control platform used for the existing admin project has sufficient capacity and permissions are already configured to allow creation of the new separate repositories.

activities.activity_name: Analyze codebase and define undeployed status semantics
activities.activity_description: Review all existing deployer SPI status handling logic, define consistent semantics for the new {{undeployed}} status (applicable to streams with no deployment context), and document expected behavior across all SPIs to ensure consistency per U7.

Set up 3 new version control repositories for Lattice, K8s, and Mesos SPIs, replicating existing project access controls, issue templates, PR review processes, and CI/CD pipeline templates from the admin project to fulfill U2, U3, U4.

activities.activity_name: Extract Lattice SPI to dedicated repository
activities.activity_description: Move all Lattice-specific implementation code, dependencies, build configuration, and existing unit/integration tests from the admin project to the new Lattice SPI repo, validate build success and test pass rates.

activities.activity_name: Extract K8s SPI to dedicated repository
activities.activity_description: Move all K8s-specific implementation code, dependencies, build configuration, and existing unit/integration tests from the admin project to the new K8s SPI repo, validate build success and test pass rates.

activities.activity_name: Extract base Mesos SPI to dedicated repository
activities.activity_description: Move all base Mesos-specific implementation code, dependencies, build configuration, and existing tests from the admin project to the new Mesos SPI repo (excluding the unreleased existing Mesos SPI work, which will be submitted via a separate PR), validate build success and test pass rates.

activities.activity_name: Implement undeployed status in CF SPI
activities.activity_description: Update CF SPI status handling logic to add the new {{undeployed}} status, update any dependent status mapping or display logic, add unit tests for the new status, and validate no regressions in existing functionality to fulfill U5.

activities.activity_name: Implement undeployed status in Lattice SPI
activities.activity_description: Update Lattice SPI status handling logic to add the new {{undeployed}} status, update any dependent status mapping or display logic, add unit tests for the new status, and validate no regressions in existing functionality to fulfill U6.

activities.activity_name: Implement undeployed status in K8s SPI
activities.activity_description: Update K8s SPI status handling logic to add the new {{undeployed}} status, update any dependent status mapping or display logic, add unit tests for the new status, and validate no regressions in existing functionality to fulfill U8.

activities.activity_name: Implement undeployed status in Mesos SPI
activities.activity_description: Update Mesos SPI status handling logic to add the new {{undeployed}} status with consistent semantics per the initial definition, add unit tests for the new status, and validate no regressions to fulfill the cross-cutting consistency requirement of U7.

Modify the admin project's build configuration to reference the new separate Lattice, K8s, and Mesos SPI repositories as dependencies instead of bundled SPI code, resolve any dependency conflicts, and validate the admin project builds and all existing tests pass.

activities.activity_name: Submit and merge PR for existing Mesos SPI work
activities.activity_description: Create a pull request in the new Mesos SPI repository for the existing unreleased Mesos SPI work, address any review feedback, resolve conflicts, and merge the PR to the main branch to fulfill U1.

Update all relevant project documentation (architecture docs, READMEs, developer guides) to reflect the new separate SPI repository structure and the behavior of the new {{undeployed}} status across all deployers.

Execute end-to-end integration tests across the admin project and all 4 SPI repositories to validate that the separate repo structure functions correctly and the {{undeployed}} status is reported consistently across all deployers with no regressions.
